
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/morec/p/19274657" title="发布于 2025-11-26 21:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">GitLab Merge Request + SonarQube：构建可量化的 .NET Core 代码评审体系</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文需要启动的服务如下：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126195356892-126250289.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;因为sonar最新版本不支持扫描多分支，所以本次演示使用了最新版本和支持多分枝扫描的老旧版本，演示环境为windows的docker-desktop。<br><br></p>
<p>先安装一下gitlab，这里不推荐做挂载，在docker-desktop上会有文件读写的权限导致运行出问题。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker run -d  -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">443</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">443</span> -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span> -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">222</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22</span> ^
--hostname mygitlab.local --name gitlab --restart always ^<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
gitlab</span>/gitlab-ce:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18.5</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>-ce.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span></pre>
</div>
<pre>在本地的C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc目录的hots下面提前配置一下域名，这是gitla安装需要的： 127.0.0.1  mygitlab.local<br>然后可以使用 mygitlab.local登录本地的git,默认的账号是root,密码看这里</pre>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126200644070-237325000.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<br>还有一个gitlab.rb文件，跟初始密码是同一个目录下，配置一下下面的变量</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126201251114-1042457109.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126201311914-2039337942.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<br>也可以使用下面命令拷贝出来改完后再拷贝进去然后重启服务</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker cp gitlab:/etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb D:\work\docker/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">gitlab.rb 拷贝出来然后替换
docker cp D:\work\docker\gitlab.rb gitlab:</span>/etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb</pre>
</div>
<pre>下面就是安装runner，首先拿到需要注入到runner中的token<br><br></pre>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126200824863-1912122250.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;下面就是启动服务的命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker run -d --name gitlab-runner ^
--restart always ^
-v d:/dwz/docker-volume/gitlab-runner/config:/etc/gitlab-runner ^
-v /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span>/run/docker.sock:/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span>/run/docker.sock ^<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
gitlab</span>/gitlab-runner:v13.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.4</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后需要注册一个runner，这里的registration-token就是gitlab拷贝出来的,url也是gitlab的地址</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker exec -it gitlab-runner gitlab-runner register -n ^
--url http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">172.17.0.2 ^</span>
--registration-token Tca8wkxwbjswexxtE_ij ^
--executor docker ^
--description <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Docker Runner</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ^
--docker-image <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli:latest</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126201131770-705709991.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>以上就是完整的gitlab和ci/cd的搭建了。注意一下docker中默认使用的网关bridge,否则都要指定一下同一个，如果网关gateway:172.17.0.2不一致就需要各种网络假如等等操作，所以安装制定好就行。上面的有默认就不需要额外配置。</p>
<p>下面继续sonar安装:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">13</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    container_name: postgres
    ports:
      </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">15432:5432</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    volumes:
      </span>- postgres_data:/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span>/lib/postgresql/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: sonar
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: sonar
      POSTGRES_DB: sonar
    network_mode: bridge

  sonar:
    image: sonarqube:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9.9</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">community
    container_name: sonar
    depends_on:
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> postgres
    ports:
      </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">9000:9000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    environment:
      SONARQUBE_JDBC_USERNAME: sonar
      SONARQUBE_JDBC_PASSWORD: sonar
      # 内部容器互访请用服务名:port（不要用容器 IP）
      SONARQUBE_JDBC_URL: jdbc:postgresql:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">postgres:5432/sonar</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    volumes:
      </span>- sonarqube_extensions:/opt/sonarqube/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">extensions
      </span>- sonarqube_logs:/opt/sonarqube/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">logs
      </span>- sonarqube_data:/opt/sonarqube/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">data
      </span>- sonarqube_conf:/opt/sonarqube/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">conf
    network_mode: bridge

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  sonarqube_extensions:
  sonarqube_logs:
  sonarqube_data:
  sonarqube_conf:</span></pre>
</div>
<p>使用docker-compose 安装完后需要手动配置一下数据库相关，还是社区版的插件安装配置等。首先安装旧版本，最后再试试新版本。</p>
<p><span style="font-family: PMingLiU">第一个插件可以就可以将</span> sonarQube <span style="font-family: PMingLiU">的审查结果以评论的试发布到 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">gitlab </span><span style="font-family: PMingLiU">上面</span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/javamachr/sonar-gitlab-plugin" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="text-decoration: underline"><span style="font-family: Calibri">https://github.com/javamachr/sonar-gitlab-plugin</span></span></a></p>
<p><span style="font-family: PMingLiU">第二个插件可以实现增强</span> <span style="font-family: Calibri">sonarQube </span><span style="font-family: PMingLiU">多分支包括</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MR</span><span style="font-family: PMingLiU">的代码检测</span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/mc1arke/sonarqube-community-branch-plugin" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="text-decoration: underline"><span style="font-family: Calibri">https://github.com/mc1arke/sonarqube-community-branch-plugin<br></span></span></a>第一个插件就固定一个最新的，第二个需要根据镜像版本来安装对应的插件和配置了。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126202412187-430835108.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>docker cp "D:\work\docker\sonar-gitlab-plugin-5.4.0.jar" 67ccc284b64a:/opt/sonarqube/extensions/plugins/&nbsp; &nbsp; （67ccc284b64a&nbsp; 是容器名）<br>docker cp "D:\work\docker\sonarqube-community-branch-plugin-25.9.0.jar" 67ccc284b64a:/opt/sonarqube/extensions/plugins/&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;（67ccc284b64a&nbsp; 是容器名）<br><br>下面需要拷贝一下配置文件然后改好覆盖进去:有五行改动，分别是数据库的配置，和第二个插件。如果配置不对或者插件版本不对都会导致服务启动不了。</p>
<p>docker cp 容器名:/opt/sonarqube/conf/sonar.properties "D:\work\docker\sonar.properties"</p>
<p>docker cp "D:\work\docker\sonar.properties" 容器名:/opt/sonarqube/conf/sonar.properties<br><br></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126202720474-1909602510.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126202729452-597190978.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126202740503-694239570.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sonar.jdbc.username=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sonar
sonar.jdbc.password</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sonar
sonar.jdbc.url</span>=jdbc:postgresql:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">172.17.0.4:5432/sonar</span>
sonar.web.javaAdditionalOpts=-javaagent:./extensions/plugins/sonarqube-community-branch-plugin-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.14</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>.jar=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">web
sonar.ce.javaAdditionalOpts</span>=-javaagent:./extensions/plugins/sonarqube-community-branch-plugin-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.14</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>.jar=ce</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>可以看到我这个文件的插件是针对老版本sonarqube:9.9-community的配置，而拷贝插件命令是最新版本的sonarqube:community的配置，最新版最后说。</p>
<p>下面就可以通过9000端口进入sonar了， 默认账号密码admin，需要进入后改掉密码。</p>
<p><br>老版本比新版本多了这个分支管理功能</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203236752-388274441.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203253603-1383277272.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<br>下面就是如何配置sonar和gitlab的交互了，这里不配置gitlab可以通过sonar继承登录 和分组权限功能，直接最高权限来做配置。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203506908-1443196942.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203607305-206610180.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203636274-1789333402.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203703671-1792167412.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>上面权限看着勾选，前面几个read少不了的。<br><br></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126203827497-1022062228.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;点击创建项目会提示你输入gitlab的personal access token，然后选择要导入的项目到gitlab，然后就关联上项目了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>在gitlab配置一下sonar的回调地址和权限即可，否则sonar拿不到runner扫描的结果</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126210433430-1091558475.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126204151427-1998927133.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p>上面的第一步需要.NET,第二步就是需要在gitlab配置两个变量<br><br></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126204417221-1508129303.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p>&nbsp;这里都是按照sonar的步骤来创建SONAR_TOKEN变量和值，然后按照要求勾选Visibility,Flags。</p>

<p><br><br></p>
<p>以上配置都完成了，下面就是在gitlab的项目中创建一个.gitlab-ci.yml文件，这个文件可以从sonar刚才的配置中拷贝也可以自己写</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
variables:
  SONAR_USER_HOME: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/.sonar</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  GIT_DEPTH: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  JAVA_VERSION: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">17</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  SONAR_PROJECT_KEY: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">root_testsonar_AZqR29AXIQF2ktGMbFvi</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  SONAR_HOST_URL: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://172.17.0.5:9000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

workflow:
  rules:
    </span>- <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" &amp;&amp; $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
    - <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE =~ /merge_request/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

stages:
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sonar

sonar_scan:
  stage: sonar
  rules:
    </span>- <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" &amp;&amp; $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
    - <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE =~ /merge_request/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  before_script:
    </span>- apt-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> update &amp;&amp; apt-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-${JAVA_VERSION}-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">jdk
    </span>- export JAVA_HOME=$(update-alternatives --query java | grep <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Best</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> | awk <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{print $5}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | sed <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s/bin\/java//</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span>- export PATH=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    - dotnet tool install --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">global</span> dotnet-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sonarscanner
    </span>- export PATH=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet/tools</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    - java -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version
    </span>- dotnet tool list -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">g
    </span>- command -v dotnet-sonarscanner || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  script:
    </span>- |
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [ -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ]; then
        # MR </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Pull Request 分析
        dotnet sonarscanner begin \
          </span>/k:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_PROJECT_KEY}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.host.url=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_HOST_URL}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.token=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_TOKEN}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.pullrequest.key=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.pullrequest.branch=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.pullrequest.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.qualitygate.wait=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.projectBaseDir=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_PROJECT_DIR}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.exclusions=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">**/bin/**,**/obj/**,**/Properties/**</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        # 普通分支（例如 main）分析
        dotnet sonarscanner begin \
          </span>/k:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_PROJECT_KEY}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.host.url=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_HOST_URL}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.token=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_TOKEN}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.branch.name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_COMMIT_BRANCH}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.qualitygate.wait=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.projectBaseDir=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_PROJECT_DIR}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
          </span>/d:sonar.exclusions=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">**/bin/**,**/obj/**,**/Properties/**</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      fi
    </span>- dotnet build --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">configuration Release
    </span>- dotnet sonarscanner end /d:sonar.token=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${SONAR_TOKEN}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  allow_failure: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  cache:
    paths:
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ${SONAR_USER_HOME}
      </span>- $HOME/.dotnet/tools</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sonarqube-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">check:
  image: mcr.microsoft.com</span>/dotnet/core/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sdk:latest
  variables:
    SONAR_USER_HOME: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/.sonar</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  # Defines the location of the analysis task cache
    GIT_DEPTH: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  # Tells git to fetch all the branches of the project, required by the analysis task
  cache:
    key: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">${CI_JOB_NAME}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    paths:
      </span>- .sonar/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cache
  script: 
      </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">apt-get update</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">apt-get install --yes openjdk-11-jre</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet tool install --global dotnet-sonarscanner</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">export PATH=\"$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet/tools\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet sonarscanner begin /k:\"root_testforsonar_AZpytHmBvMocvQWN9yIR\" /d:sonar.login=\"$SONAR_TOKEN\" /d:\"sonar.host.url=$SONAR_HOST_URL\" </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet build</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
      - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet sonarscanner end /d:sonar.login=\"$SONAR_TOKEN\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  allow_failure: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  only:
    </span>- main</pre>
</div>
<p>以上都可以，经供参考<br>只有一点注意：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126205332115-1131757743.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126205343597-469783579.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;上面的这个<code>SONAR_PROJECT_KEY来自于<br></code></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126205452110-1219064288.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><code>然后提交和并请求（哪里触发代码审查可以根据yml文件配置写的来）会扫描代码，展示代码问题了<br></code></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126205544964-95866795.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><code>下面是最新的sonar的安装<br></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker exec -it postgres psql -U sonar -c <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE DATABASE sonar2;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

docker run </span>-d ^
  --name sonar2 ^
  --network bridge ^
  -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9001</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9000</span> ^
  -e SONARQUBE_JDBC_URL=jdbc:postgresql:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">postgres:5432/sonar2 ^</span>
  -e SONARQUBE_JDBC_USERNAME=sonar ^
  -e SONARQUBE_JDBC_PASSWORD=sonar ^
  -v sonarqube2_extensions:/opt/sonarqube/extensions ^
  -v sonarqube2_logs:/opt/sonarqube/logs ^
  -v sonarqube2_data:/opt/sonarqube/data ^
  -v sonarqube2_conf:/opt/sonarqube/conf ^<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  sonarqube:community</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>最新版本的sonar没有分支管理功能，只能查看一个分支的扫描统计，gitlab评论展示功能不变，配置好对应版本插件就行。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202511/1099890-20251126205912863-1484603451.png" class="lazyload"></p>
